summary: EXOS supports CLI over SSH (network_cli) and EXOS-API over HTTP(S) (httpapi), no enable mode, output stdout[0] or stdout[0].messages[0]; connection local is not supported.
questions: What connection types does Extreme EXOS support?
Can I use connection local with EXOS?

answer_card.title: EXOS connection options
answer_card.answer_md:
| | CLI | EXOS-API |
|---|---|---|
| Protocol | SSH | HTTP(S) |
| Credentials | SSH keys/agent or `-u myuser -k` | HTTPS certificates if present |
| Indirect access | bastion/jump host | web proxy |
| `ansible_connection` | `ansible.netcommon.network_cli` | `ansible.netcommon.httpapi` |
| Enable mode | not supported | not supported |
| Output | `stdout[0].` | `stdout[0].messages[0].` |

`ansible_connection: local` is not supported.
